verdict_reason: The anyNotInUnionOf sample correctly keeps the coverage gate whole, but comments and a failure message name a nonexistent analysis/reachability.js and a synthesiseWitness switch the PR removed, and the file keeps the abbreviations the sibling test just renamed.

todos.issue: Comments and a failure message point at code that is not there. Lines 22, 159, 164 and the assertion message at 294 send the reader to 'analysis/reachability.js', which does not exist (the sets live in reachability/witness/kinds.js), so a failing invariant #4 tells the developer to edit the wrong file. Lines 4, 25-28, 42-43, 177-187 and 198-211 say the case labels live in synthesiseWitness's top-level switch and that 'any new helper type belongs in the top-level switch of synthesiseWitness'; after this PR's synthesise.js refactor synthesiseWitness has no switch and list types go in LIST_GATE_TYPES plus synthesiseListGateWitness. Line 14 ('a sixth helper') and line 40 ('Add a new helper notInUnionOf', which already exists) are counts and history.
todos.fix: Must: every comment and assertion message in coverage.test.js names files and functions that exist and describes how dispatch works now, with no counts or history. One way: point the message at reachability/witness/kinds.js, cut the file header and section banners to what each test asserts, and drop the 'sixth helper' and notInUnionOf examples.

One concept, two vocabularies across the two analysis test files.
